files.description: The registered URL page (ONC Certification page). Contains the EHI export section at lines 1292-1299 with three paragraphs describing CSV export via a built-in SQL query. No data dictionary, no downloadable files.
files.curl_command: curl -sL 'https://www.officepracticum.com/op/population-health/onc-certification' -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36' -o downloads/onc-certification-page.html

files.description: Mandatory disclosures page with accordion sections including 'Electronic Health Information Export'. Contains identical EHI export text as the registered URL. Accordion requires JavaScript click to expand.
files.curl_command: curl -sL 'https://www.officepracticum.com/onc-certification-info' -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36' -o downloads/onc-certification-info-disclosures.html

files.description: 2025 Real World Test Results Report (10 pages). Page 7 contains EHI Export results: 2,861 single-patient exports, 20 bulk exports across 5 test practices. Confirms the feature works but provides no technical details about export contents.
files.curl_command: curl -sL 'https://hub.officepracticum.com/hubfs/OP%20Website/OP_RWT_Results_Report_2025.pdf' -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36' -o downloads/OP_RWT_Results_Report_2025.pdf
